$comment: Declared, reasoned differences between mirror-test and the daily desktop profile. parity.py fails on any difference not listed here.

bundles.@local/dsh-mobile-connection: Publishes a Tailscale endpoint; the test instance does not expose a network service.
bundles.dsh-codex-oauth: Needs a personal ChatGPT subscription login; credentials are not copied.
bundles.@local/phanthy-dsh-bundle: Needs a personal model gateway and its account.
bundles.@superbei/dsh-project-workbench: Developed outside this repository; installed from its own working copy, not a pinned commit.

rows.llm-pi-ai: Model channels and their credentials are set inside each instance, never in git.
rows.agent-default-model: The test instance picks its own default model.
rows.connection: The remote access address differs per instance.
rows.mobile-connection: Plugin not installed in the test instance.
rows.phanthy-models: Plugin not installed in the test instance.
rows.plugin-market: Index sources are a personal preference.
rows.ui-theme: Theme is stored in the instance's local settings.
rows.ui-settings: Settings-page switches with no behavioural effect.
rows.agent-preset-registry: The test instance uses the bundle default, which equals the daily effective value.
rows.permission: The test instance uses the bundle default preset, which equals the daily effective value.
rows.cua: Holds the machine-local helperPath; the CUA bundles are disabled in both instances.
rows.local-team-only: The coordinator prompt is personal content; the test instance keeps the plugin default.
rows.web: Search and fetch providers need personal API access.

ui-chat.performanceUsage: Client display preference stored in the instance's local settings.
ui-chat.linkOpening: Client display preference stored in the instance's local settings.
